About
Immerse yourself in the creative sanctuary of CJAM Tattoo, a private studio nestled in the heart of Bellingham, WA, where the mastery of illustrative, fineline, and lettering tattoos transforms skin into a canvas of personal expression. Adhering to the highest standards of safety, masks remain a mandatory accessory within this artistic haven. Discover the distinct vision of @cjamtattoos, @cougartooth, and @lionbearcobrashark, where every inked creation is a testament to their dedication and craft.
